background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, ratings that rest on a fee-based custody model rather than lending. Leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, while CET1 of 12.0% is just below the peer median and LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, the one figure to keep an eye on. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points, while LCR has been broadly flat. Flagged news in the last 90 days is positive, quarterly results ahead of estimates on 22 Jul 2026.
